Friday Visit Report – Baneshwor Area  Dear Team,  Please find below the summary of my Friday visits to consultancies in the Baneshwor area:  1. Dot Consultancy  I visited Dot Consultancy and met with the team to discuss their current applications and future plans. They currently have around 32 UK applications and are also interested in applying for Finland and Canada through UCA.  They are looking for guidance on how to effectively promote the Finland marketing tool, as they are particularly focused on social media promotion. They requested that we arrange a meeting with their Director, Mr. Sujan Dhakal, to discuss the marketing strategy and provide proper training.  The training can be conducted either at their office or online, depending on our availability.  2. Channel Consultancy  I also visited Channel Consultancy, and they requested our support in promoting New Zealand and Canada programs.  They have previously submitted applications through us for the UK market. However, they mentioned that one of their students created issues during the process, which ultimately resulted in a visa refusal.  Despite this experience, they remain interested in working with us for New Zealand and Canada and requested our support in promoting these destinations.  3. Student Folio Consultancy  Student Folio Consultancy is mainly focusing on the European market through UCA. They have already received a visa for LearnKey (Malta) but are currently facing some concerns regarding the recent commission changes. They requested updated information regarding the revised commission structure.  They also collect files/applications through their sub-agents. The consultancy has recently started working with IDB Global, as they mentioned that our commission is lower compared to IDP. However, they are still interested in submitting applications through UCA.  They also mentioned that they have already received a visa for Finland and requested an advance marketing budget from our side. Their reason is that they generate the leads themselves and send the applications exclusively to UCA.  Considering the current situation, they requested that we discuss a suitable marketing budget and set a specific student recruitment target for Europe.  4. Best Wishes Consultancy  Best Wishes Consultancy is satisfied with our services and expressed interest in promoting multiple destinations through UCA.  They requested our support in promoting Asia, Canada, New Zealand, and Europe. They are interested in increasing their cooperation with us across these destinations and would appreciate marketing and promotional support from our side.  5. Leadahead Consultancy  Leadahead Consultancy is aware that UCA is onboarding them, but they currently have limited knowledge about our products and services. Their main focus is Australia through GSP.  During the visit, we provided them with a session on Canada and New Zealand to increase their understanding of these destinations and support future enquiries and promotions.  Although they were onboarded with UCA in 2024, they have not yet generated any applications through UCA. I encouraged them to actively utilize UCA's services and suggested creating a WhatsApp group for regular communication, product updates, and information sharing regarding our departments and services.  They have a team of 10+ staff members with good communication skills, which provides strong potential for business development. However, regular follow-up will be required due to the previous lack of proper communication with UCA.  He committed to working with us, and I assured him that I would visit their office regularly based on their requirements to provide support, product updates, and guidance.  Overall Observation  Overall, the Friday visits were productive, and the consultancies showed good potential for further business development. The key areas requiring follow-up are product training, marketing support, commission clarification, regular communication, and setting specific recruitment targets for  Uk,Asia ,Australia,USA,Europe, Canada, and New Zealand.  I will continue to follow up with these consultancies and provide the necessary support to strengthen our partnerships and generate applications through UCA.  Best regards, Manisha Phuyal
